rooms.name: Garden veranda
rooms.description: Open the shutters to the garden. A shaded veranda leaves room for a book and a slow cup of tea.
rooms.access: Ground floor. Two entrance steps; no step-free bathroom.

rooms.name: Tea-view double
rooms.description: An upstairs room looking out towards the tea rows, with a little sitting corner by the window.
rooms.access: First floor, stairs only. Bathroom within the room.

rooms.name: Courtyard twin
rooms.description: Two beds, a quiet courtyard outlook and a simple place to rest between days outdoors.
rooms.access: Ground floor. One entrance step; narrow bathroom doorway.

rooms.name: Hill-facing double
rooms.description: Morning light falls across the room. The window looks towards the low green hills.
rooms.access: First floor, stairs only. Shared landing outside.

rooms.name: Family veranda
rooms.description: Our room for a small family, with separate beds and a veranda for time together.
rooms.access: Ground floor. Three veranda steps. No lift or ramp.

rooms.name: Quiet corner
rooms.description: A small room tucked away from the veranda. A considered choice for a solo stay.
rooms.access: Ground floor. One step at the entrance; compact bathroom.

experiences.name: A morning in the tea gardens
experiences.description: Follow the paths between the tea rows, pause in the shade and take the morning at walking pace.
experiences.includes: A guided walk and a cup of tea. Wear closed shoes and bring water.
experiences.access: Uneven earth paths, with some slopes. Not step-free. Weather may change the route.

experiences.name: Tea at the family table
experiences.description: Sit down for a shared pot of tea and a conversation about the leaves in your cup.
experiences.includes: A hosted tea session with a small seasonal snack. Tell us about food allergies when booking.
experiences.access: Seated at the house. Two steps to the veranda; ask about access needs before travel.
